intro: Marrow Ministries exists to serve local churches through the experience and heart of Dr. Tim Marrow — a Texas-raised pastor with over four decades of ministry across New Mexico and Texas. A graduate of Howard Payne University and Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary, Dr. Marrow brings a lifetime of pastoral wisdom to churches in every season — whether in transition, in growth, or in need of encouragement.
emphasis: Marrow Ministries is committed to walking alongside pastors and congregations, offering steady, experienced guidance so churches can thrive for the sake of the Gospel.
